newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SEVILLA SUSPEND TRANSFER PAYMENT TO ARGENTINE CLUB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SEVILLA SUSPEND TRANSFER PAYMENT TO ARGENTINE CLUB.

text.p: Spanish club Sevilla said on Monday it had suspended payment to Argentine side Rosario Central for midfielder Christian Colusso after discovering what appeared to be forged signatures on the transfer documents.
Sevilla vice-president Francisco Escobar said no more payments would be made until the matter was cleared up.
He said the club would start legal action but did not specify against whom the action would be taken.
Escobar made the announcement after the ABC daily published pictures of the documentation belonging to the two clubs in which the signatures of the Rosario officials do not match.
There is also disagreement as to how much of Colusso's $1.7 million transfer fee has been paid. Colusso moved to the Spanish club earlier this year.
